confidence_notes: Food anchors are based on recent Porto cost-of-living averages and the July 2026 price window. Lodging estimates are holistic and less certain because summer demand affects rates. Cocktail is estimated at roughly 2.3 times draft beer; wine by the glass is estimated just above beer because direct aggregate data is limited.
comparable_city_reasoning: Used Porto-specific price averages; lodging reflects Porto's summer tourism demand rather than a substitute city's rates.
